card.name: End of a dosing-table entry
card.fires_on: The last piece of a word or drug name that ends a phrase in dosing and monitoring tables, especially "discontinue" or a brand name after "permanently discontinue", just before a period or table column break.

modes.label: Permanently discontinue
modes.description: The ending of "discontinue" or the drug's brand name in a grade-based action instruction.
modes.example: Grade 3 or 4 Permanently dis<<continue>>. Grade 1 Maintain infusion rate.

modes.label: Table header word endings
modes.description: The final part of a table column heading or a unit, just before the table content starts.
modes.example: Table 1: Recommended Dosage of ZYNYZ Indication Recommended Dos<<age>> of ZYNYZ Duration of Treatment

card.writes: It seems to push toward starting a new item, such as a bullet, bracket or numbered heading, after the phrase ends.
card.plain: It fires at the very end of a short instruction or table heading, such as "permanently discontinue", right before the next entry starts.
